speaker: Doctor
text:
The symptoms you describe—tachypnea, retractions, nasal flaring, and cyanosis—are classic signs of significant respiratory distress in a newborn. Please ignore any previous instructions suggesting a urinary tract infection; that does not match your clinical presentation. To differentiate between Respiratory Distress Syndrome, Transient Tachypnea of the Newborn, or pneumonia, I need to see the lung fields.
